purpose: Separate implementation sentinels whose rate-fidelity outputs were inspected during harness validation from the untouched confirmatory rate-fidelity cohort before the corpus-scale run.

implementation_sentinels.role: AFLOW pre-VASP5 provenance/parser and end-to-end implementation sentinel

confirmatory_rate_fidelity_cohort.definition: all records in external_test_MANIFEST.json except the two implementation sentinels

reporting_policy.all_65: Run and release row-level results for completeness; treat rate-fidelity summaries as descriptive because two implementation sentinels were inspected before the corpus-scale run.
reporting_policy.confirmatory_63: Primary external rate-fidelity generalization statistics and manuscript headline external comparisons.
reporting_policy.stability_validation: Unchanged. Protocol A.1 stability was already evaluated on the frozen 65-system corpus under the separately documented stability-validation protocol.

selection_policy: The two exclusions are determined solely by prior rate-fidelity inspection during implementation validation, not by whether their codec results were favorable or unfavorable. No additional material may be moved between sets after this file is frozen.
